text: The Uryashi are a humanoid mountain people with great physical strength who are derogatorily called goatfaces by humans.
Vladimir was connected to a rebel cell in Svatra, the capital of Veil Sangora, planning an uprising against Vrakieri rule.
Ambress kept a private herd of humans to feed on despite Brenis officially forbidding that practice among the Verkieri.
Cohen was voted into the Manumits, a group opposing Verkieri tyranny, with only Dro voting against him.
Craig (Marat) told Cohen that the Manumits plan to help Catalin, son of the former ruler Scander, overthrow Kinaz Brenis by opening the mountain pass gates from within.

Hila appears to be a young girl but has actually been kept childlike for 10 years by the magic of the Sanjani, small fae-like beings who live in burrows; they found her in the forest and brought her to live with them, using their magic to keep her from aging.
The Sanjani have a peculiar fascination with collecting human teeth as gifts for their rulers, called Sarinas.
By this point in the story, two of Brenis's Boyars, Ambress and Bakir, were already dead, leaving only the witch Zanthy.
Nebaru offers Cohen a purpose from the Council of Augers, saying eternity is unbearable without one.
